title: Electrophysiologic Parameters and Biomarkers Predicting Treatment Response in Patients With Major Depressive Disorder
brief_summary: To explore electrophysiologic parameters and biomarkers predicting treatment response of patients with major depressive disorder To explore electrophysiologic parameters and biomarkers predicting suicide risk of patients with major depressive disorder
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* DSM-IV-TR major depressive disorder
* aged between 20 and 80
* durg-naive or drug-free

Exclusion Criteria:

* DSM-IV-TR substance-related disorders (except nicotine)
* significant medical or neurological conditions
* mental retardation or organic brain damage
